== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Mournful Roar, 2017 edition, for [[Mournful Roar (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].

Source: [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf] (“Official text as of March 1, 2017”, PDF made 31 May 2017), page 8; archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf 20170705005900] (5 July 2017).
